renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Thinking hard is knowing yourself. The world's joy is deep-meditation joy. When power joins, a body forms. Joined and separate, the world packs into one. Pure wisdom rising makes you lord of the wheel. Think on the vast lake, taste the mantra's charge.
